title: Page 6
lines: “被你爹许出来我真是倒了八辈子的楣……”博格朗坐在马背上，拿着一条汗巾边擦着脸边不断碎碎念。
“被你娘许出来我绝对是倒了九辈子的楣……”一身伤痕累累的海冬青，则趴在另一匹马的背上，有气无力的跟着抱怨。
坐在豪华大马车内，被他俩唠叨了一路的文家大少爷文谨，烦不胜烦地揭开车帘，看向这两名由他爹娘许愿许出来的魂役兼他的贴身保镖。
“够了，我文家一直都好吃好喝的将你们供着，你们还有什么不满？”华屋美服、奴仆成群不说，还给了他们天价的保镖费，再嫌弃就太没道德了。
岂料他俩却齐声怒吼：“太多了！”
试问，这年头有哪个魂役当得比他俩还心酸的？
绝对没有。
为了保护这名小命比金子还要贵，且身兼百年商业世家继承人的大少爷，这十年来，他俩中毒超过百次，挨刀子的次数多到他们身上的伤痕数也数不清，都可以拿来搓麻绳了！
偏偏文谨他就是不安生，自从他的双亲于十年前出门周游列国兼游山玩水后，接下文府新一任少当家的他，不老实点乖乖待在文府里主持商务，偏要身体力行到处跑生意，完全都不想想文家在外头的商业对头有多少、仇家又有多少，每每陪着他出门谈一趟生意，他们就跟去了条命没两样，再这般被这灾祸不断的大少爷折腾下去，他们就算有九条命也只剩下半条了！
博格朗愈想心底就愈有火，“我同你爹约定过，我保护你的时间只有十一年而已，只要明年一到期，我就不干你的保镖了。反正你又不是我的魂主，凭什么要我一年到头的为你抛头颅洒热血？有本事你就自己去许个魂役出来，别老占用你爹娘的！”
“你娘当年还骗我，说什么只要顾着你的小命十一年就好……”海冬青哀怨地咬着唇，“我又不是大罗神仙，哪能次次都冒险犯难救你于水火？求求大少爷你就高抬贵手另觅高明，放我一条生路吧！”
陈年老调又再次被他俩重新弹起，文谨不禁无奈地抚着额。
“别吵了，我尽快再找一名武艺高强的相级保镖就是。”说来说去就是他们想辞职不干。
“最好是这样！”这话他们都听多少年了？
马车缓缓走在男儿国京城的青石砖大道上，在抵达城心不久，一座占地极广，有着文家象徵白墙黑瓦的府宅大院即映入眼帘，而文谨只看了外头早就聚集在此等他返家的人们一眼，便觉得两际又开始隐隐犯疼。
护卫在马车左右的两名保镖下马之后，一个专心抹着头上还没擦干的血迹，另一个则拖着一瘸一拐的步子准备进府疗伤，可候在府门前的人们却像没看见他们似的，毫不客气地挤开他们后，一个个上了年纪的老人家便健步如飞地直奔向刚下马车的文谨。
“谨儿啊！”
“少当家啊！”
一下车就被自家长辈们围堵，对于此景，文谨已是习以为常了。他振振衣袖，而后将两手拱在袖中弯身向他们请安。
“大伯公三叔公五叔六叔七叔……我回来了。”
“好孩子，回来就好、回来就好……”几位老人家在确定他真是毫发无损的回家来后，纷纷放下了心来。
文谨再有礼地朝他们一揖，压根就不敢多作逗留，“一连数日奔波，眼下孙儿也累了，请容孙儿先去休息洗漱，改日再去向诸位长辈请安。”
“慢着！”并不打算就这么放过他的几位叔叔，在他抬脚准备走人的那一刻，眼明手快地拦住他的去路。
“我说谨儿啊……”文家五叔漾着和蔼的笑容，“这回出去相亲……相得怎么样啊？”
“美女很多。”望着这一票虎视耽耽的长辈，文谨小心地挑捡着字眼，尽量选择能说的。
“喔？”众人的眼底霎时燃起希望的光芒。
他谨慎地再道：“知书达礼的大家闺秀也不少。”
“那……”早就对大少夫人望穿秋水的众人，更是兴奋地屏住了气息。
“只可惜大少他东挑西捡就是没一个看得上眼。”偏偏博格朗就是不会看眼色，不疾不徐地泼了盆冷水。
“更别说还有一堆要命不要钱的女人，哪怕咱们出的聘礼再怎么丰厚诱人，她们就是抵死都不肯嫁给他。”海冬青也不落人后，就唯恐天下不够乱。
来不及掩上他俩快嘴的文谨，只能皱着眉，看着包围他的长辈们在下一瞬间齐齐变脸，一个个扯开了老嗓开始嚎哭。
“苍天啊！”
“我文家命苦哇……”
“难道我文家血脉就要断在这一代了吗？”
“你们惹的，你们负责摆平。”文谨头痛地拖过两名不肖保镖挡驾，然后当机立断地撇下他们往府门的方向钻。
逃进门内靠在大门上深深喘了口气后，文谨都还没有机会庆幸又逃过一回泪灾，就见府中一个个家仆都候在门内等着他不说，他们的神情还格外整齐划一，都是一脸恹恹提不起劲来的模样，其中几个小厮还垂头丧气，不时偷偷拉着衣袖抹眼泪。
“大少爷，您回来了。”文府的大总管文伯，带着亲切的笑意走上前。
“这是怎么回事？”文谨指着那些纷纷拖着沉重脚步走开的家仆问道。
文伯无奈地道：“他们听说三位少爷今早接到飞鸽传书，知道大少爷这回又没带大少夫人回来后，就都这个样了。”
“告诉他们振作点，下回我肯定给他们带个大少夫人回来。”又不是头一回没带回来了，有必要沮丧成那样？
“他们已经不吃这套了……”就连他也是。
文谨疲惫地叹了口气，转身走进大厅，却没见着每回在他返家时，一定会等着欢迎他的那三个弟弟。
“兔崽子们呢？”
“二少和三少说，不给大嫂不上工。”那两位弃生意于不顾的少爷给他的理由是，打击太大，顿觉人生无望，他们要结伴去疗伤。
“四少说，不给大嫂不吃饭，还有也不认大哥了。”那个今年才十岁的小少爷，天没亮就蹲在府门前痴痴的等待未来大嫂，在知道自家大哥这回又没能成功拐个媳妇回家后，足足哭了一早都不歇。
文谨揉着刺痛的两际，“知道了，你先去外头替我哄哄老人家们，别让他们哭太久……”
打发走文伯后，文谨泄了气似的瘫坐在大椅里，此刻在他脑海里来来去去的，全是那一张张失望无比的面孔。
他也知道，全族的老老少少，是有多么期待他这回出远门能带个少夫人回来，可梦想始终是个梦想，现实该残忍依旧还是那般残忍，空手而回的他仍旧找不着他们口中所说的少夫人，也再一次地让他们多年来的盼望粉碎得像颗泡泡。
随着期待而来的，是失望，而在失望过后，总免不了会有些怨怼。
这些年来，他都不知听过几回他们的抱怨与责难。每个人都认为，他在寻找妻子的这方面，不够尽心也不够投入，更加没有什么满腔的热情……说来说去他至今会仍然娶无妻，问题都是出在他不够努力。
但，娶妻这回事，真的仅仅是只要他够努力就能办到的吗？
不，这与努力与否无关，因它比登天还难了不只那么一点点。
至于原因？
不为什么，就因他们所处的这个国家，是座男儿国。

Chapter 1(1)
"Being promised by your father is really a disgrace for eight lifetimes..." Bogrand sat on the horse, wiping his face with a sweat towel and kept thinking.
"I will definitely be ruined for nine lifetimes by your mother..." Hai Dongqing, who was covered in scars, lay on the back of another horse and complained weakly.
Sitting in the luxurious carriage, Wen Jin, the eldest young master of the Wen family, who had been nagged by them all the way, opened the curtain of the carriage in annoyance and looked at the two soul servants who were promised by his parents and his personal bodyguards.
"That's enough. My Wen family has always provided you with delicious food and drinks. What are you dissatisfied with?" Not only do they have beautiful houses, beautiful clothes, and hordes of servants, they also pay them sky-high bodyguard fees. It would be too immoral to dislike them any more.
Unexpectedly, they both roared in unison: "Too many!"
Let me ask, is there any soul servant these days who is more miserable than the two of them?
Absolutely not.
In order to protect this young man whose life is more valuable than gold and who is also the heir to a century-old business family, they have been poisoned more than a hundred times in the past ten years and have been stabbed so many times that they have countless scars on their bodies, which they can use to twist hemp rope!
However, Wen Jin is restless. Ever since his parents traveled around the world ten years ago, he took over as the new young head of the Wen Mansion. Instead of being honest and staying in the Wen Mansion to take charge of business, he insists on doing business everywhere, without even thinking about it. Thinking about how many business rivals and enemies the Wen family has outside, every time they go out with him to discuss business, it feels like they have lost their lives. If they continue to be tormented by this young master who keeps causing troubles, even if they have nine lives, they will only have half of them left!
The more Bogrand thought about it, the more angry he became. "I made an agreement with your father that I will only protect you for eleven years. As soon as it expires next year, I will stop being your bodyguard. Anyway, you are not my soul master, so why should I sacrifice my life and blood for you all year round? If you have the ability, just go and get a soul service by yourself, and don't always take advantage of your parents!"
"Your mother lied to me back then, saying that she only needed to take care of your life for eleven years..." Hai Dongqing bit her lip sadly, "I'm not a great god, so how can I take risks and save you from fire and water every time? I beg you, young master, to find a way out for me and let me live!"
The old tune was played again by the two of them, and Wen Jin could not help but stroke his forehead helplessly.
"Stop arguing, I'll find a prime minister-level bodyguard with strong martial arts skills as soon as possible." All told, they wanted to resign.
"It's best this way!" How many years have they heard this?
The carriage walked slowly along the bluestone avenue of the capital of the man's country. Soon after arriving in the center of the city, a huge mansion with white walls and black tiles, the symbol of the Wen family, came into view. Wen Jin only glanced at the people who had gathered outside waiting for him to return home, and felt a faint pain between his eyes again.
After the two bodyguards guarding the carriage dismounted, one concentrated on wiping the blood on his head that had not been wiped dry, while the other limped and prepared to enter the mansion for treatment. However, the people waiting in front of the mansion seemed not to see them. After rudely pushing them away, the elderly people walked straight towards Wen Jin who had just got off the carriage.
"Jin'er!"
"Don't be in charge!"
As soon as he got off the car, he was surrounded by his elders. Wen Jin was used to this scene. He puffed up his sleeves, put his hands in them and bowed to greet them.
"First uncle, third uncle, fifth uncle, sixth uncle, seventh uncle... I'm back."
"Good boy, just come back, just come back..." Several elderly people felt relieved after confirming that he had returned home unscathed.
No matter how politely Wen Jin bowed to them, he did not dare to stay longer at all. "I have been running around for several days and now my grandson is tired. Please allow me to rest and wash up first, and then I will pay my respects to the elders another day."
"Wait a minute!" Several uncles who didn't intend to let him go just like that, blocked his way with quick eyesight and quick hands when he was about to leave.
"I'm talking about Jin'er..." The fifth uncle of the Wen family smiled kindly, "We went on a blind date this time... How did it go?"
"There are many beauties." Looking at the crowd of glaring elders, Wen Jin carefully picked out the words and tried his best to choose the ones he could say.
"Oh?" Everyone's eyes suddenly lit up with hope.
He cautiously added: "There are many ladies among us who are knowledgeable and courteous."
"Then..." The people who had already looked at the eldest lady held their breath with excitement.
"It's a pity that the young master picked here and there but no one caught his eye." However, Bogrand just didn't know how to look at him and poured cold water on him without hesitation.
"Not to mention there are a bunch of women who want nothing more than their lives. No matter how generous the betrothal gift we offer is, they will not marry him even to death." Hai Dongqing is not lagging behind, because she is afraid that the world is not chaotic enough.
Wen Jin, who had no time to cover up their quick words, could only frown and watch as the elders surrounding him all changed their faces in the next moment, and each one started to cry at the top of his voice.
"Oh my God!"
"My Wen family has a miserable life..."
"Is the bloodline of our Wen family about to end in this generation?"
"You guys caused it, you are responsible for settling it." Wen Jin dragged the two unscrupulous bodyguards out of the way with a headache, then left them behind and headed towards the door of the house without hesitation.
After escaping inside and leaning on the door to take a deep breath, Wen Jin didn't even have the chance to be thankful that he had escaped the tears again. He saw that all the servants in the house were waiting for him inside the door without saying a word. Their expressions were particularly neat and uniform, and they all looked like they were languid and unmotivated. Some of the servants were still downcast, secretly pulling on their sleeves to wipe away tears from time to time.
"Young Master, you are back." Uncle Wen, the chief steward of the Wen Mansion, stepped forward with a friendly smile.
"What's going on?" Wen Jin asked, pointing to the servants who were dragging their heavy footsteps away.
Uncle Wen said helplessly: "They heard that the three young masters received a letter from Fei Ge this morning, and they all became like this after knowing that the eldest young master did not bring the eldest young lady back this time."
"Tell them to cheer up. I will definitely bring them a young lady next time." It's not the first time I didn't bring them back. Is it necessary to be so depressed?
"They don't do this anymore..." Even he did.
Wen Jin sighed tiredly, turned around and walked into the hall, but he didn't see the three younger brothers who would always be waiting to welcome him when he returned home.
"Where are the bastards?"
"The second young master and the third young master said that if you don't pay for your sister-in-law, you won't be able to work." The reason given to him by the two young masters who gave up the business was that the blow was too great and they suddenly felt that life was hopeless, so they wanted to go together to heal.
"..."
"The fourth young master said that if he doesn't give his sister-in-law, he won't eat, and he won't recognize his elder brother." The young master, who was only ten years old this year, squatted in front of the house before dawn, waiting for his future sister-in-law. After knowing that his elder brother failed to bring home a wife this time, he cried all morning.
Wen Jin rubbed the stinging cheeks and said, "I know, you go outside to comfort the elderly people for me first, don't let them cry for too long..."
"Yes."
After sending Uncle Wen away, Wen Jin slumped down in the big chair as if frustrated. All that came and went in his mind at the moment were all the disappointed faces.
He also knew how much the whole family, young and old, expected him to bring back a young lady from his trip, but the dream was always a dream, and the reality was still as cruel as it should be. When he returned empty-handed, he still couldn't find the young lady they talked about, and once again, their hopes for many years were shattered like bubbles.
With expectations comes disappointment, and after the disappointment, there is always some resentment.
Over the years, he had heard their complaints and accusations countless times. Everyone thinks that he is not dedicated enough or dedicated enough in finding a wife, nor is he full of enthusiasm... After all, he is still married without a wife. The problem is that he does not work hard enough.
But, is getting a wife really just something he can do if he works hard enough?
No, it has nothing to do with hard work, because it is just a little bit harder than climbing to the sky.
As for the reason?
No reason, just because the country they live in is a country of men.
